relationships.subject: Estrogen
relationships.evidence_quote: estrogen has been shown to increase the expression of TRPV1 (Transient Receptor Potential Vanilloid 1) in sensory neurons

relationships.subject: Microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: the persistent pain phenotype observed in SS rats has been suggested to result from microglial activation

key_findings: Review argues inherited rodent models (SS rat, consomic strains, transgenic mice) capture polygenic susceptibility to chronic pain without injury.
Neuroimmune signaling, microglia and epigenetic priming are highlighted as mechanisms.
